name: loop-foundry
description: End-to-end pipeline for applying the loop-engineering approach to a project's task backlog: applicability assessment, YouTrack task triage, LOOP_SPEC authoring, runner generation, gap analysis, and a staged launch ladder (shadow → gated → autonomous) with measured approval rates. The human stays the architect: every phase ends in a hard STOP for approval. Companion: prediction-protocol — receipts for one-way commands in every tick, required past shadow.
